summary: "Troijan Helena yksityiselämässään" by John Erskine is a novel published in 1925. This reimagining of the Helen of Troy legend follows the famous beauty after the fall of Troy as she returns to Sparta with her husband Menelaus. Rather than face execution for her scandalous affair with Paris, Helen must navigate marriage, motherhood, and friendship while defending her choices. Presenting Helen as a progressive woman who challenges traditional expectations about female sexuality and marriage, this best-selling work offers a modern, satirical take on ancient Greek mythology.
